## Analysis overview

Restricts to ITT subjects, counts analysis-population membership by pooled site, site, and treatment, derives site totals, and pivots the counts into the final display.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `SITEGR1`: pooled site grouping
- `SITEID`: study site identifier
- `TRT01P`: planned treatment
- `ITTFL`: intent-to-treat flag
- `EFFFL`: efficacy population flag
- `COMP24FL`: Week 24 completion flag.
